source.post_text:
#HOTD Season 3 has been such a fun ride for me, with some really strong performances, great character moments, some genuinely unforgettable episodes.. like Episode 3's POV style storytelling and the brilliantly written Episode 5, which I absolutely loved. It's been an entertaining season, and now we're finally at the end of the road. 

The massive Season 3 finale airs TOMORROW!! And it'll be the fourth big episode of the season, following Episodes 1, 2 and 7. 🔥

replies.text: Season really nailed those big character beats and the standout eps felt fresh. Hoping the finale sticks the landing without forcing any side to look weak just for drama.

replies.text: I loved it Too. So Hyped for Sunday
